aboutText: Patios & Carports Melbourne has been serving Sunshine North for over 12 years, specialising in custom carports and pergolas. We understand Melbourne's unique climate and design structures that are built to last. Choose from a range of custom roof styles, from sleek curved designs to practical flat and gable options, all engineered to withstand local weather. Visit our Sunshine North factory to feel the quality of our Australian-made steel and see your project take shape before we build.
servicesText: We specialise in constructing high-quality carports and pergolas designed to complement your home and withstand local weather conditions. Our services include custom designs, durable steel structures, and professional installation. With over 12 years in Sunshine North, we offer tailored solutions for residential and commercial spaces, ensuring longevity and style.
